user.title: UniFi WAN
user.description: Enter your UniFi OS connection details.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate UniFi WAN
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {host} is no longer valid. Enter a new API key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure UniFi WAN
reconfigure.description: Change the address, API key or site this gateway is reached at. Entities and their history are kept. The speedtest schedule is under Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the console. Check the Host/IP (just the address, no https:// or port) and that TCP port 443 is open from Home Assistant to the console.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Use a local API key created on the console under Settings > Control Plane > Integrations (requires UniFi Network 9.0+). Keys from unifi.ui.com are not supported.
error.invalid_site: The console returned 404 Not Found. Check the site name (usually 'default', not the display name) and that the console runs UniFi OS (UDM/UDR/UXG/Cloud Key with firmware 2.x or later).
error.ssl_error: SSL certificate verification failed. Turn off 'Verify SSL certificate' unless your console has a valid trusted certificate.
error.timeout: The console did not respond within 30 seconds. Check the Host/IP and that no firewall is blocking TCP port 443.

abort.already_configured: This UniFi controller and site is already configured.
abort.wrong_console: That address answers with a different gateway from the one this entry was set up for. Reconfigure keeps this entry's entities, so it can only follow the same gateway to a new address or site. Add the other gateway as a separate integration entry.

data.api_key: API key (leave blank to keep current)
data.expected_download_mbps: ISP expected download speed (Mbit/s, 0 to disable)
data.expected_upload_mbps: ISP expected upload speed (Mbit/s, 0 to disable)

data_description.expected_download_mbps: What your line is sold as. The ISP download speed status sensor compares each speedtest against it and reports Expected, Faster or Slower. Leave at 0 if you would rather not compare.
data_description.expected_upload_mbps: What your line is sold as. The ISP upload speed status sensor compares each speedtest against it and reports Expected, Faster or Slower. Leave at 0 if you would rather not compare.
data_description.speed_tolerance_percent: How far either side of the expected speed still counts as meeting it. At 2%, a 500 Mbit/s line reads Expected between 490 and 510. Widen it for a connection that varies by time of day; 0 means only an exact match counts.

run_speedtest.name: Run speedtest
run_speedtest.description: Trigger a manual speedtest on the active UniFi gateway immediately.

wan.name: WAN interface
wan.description: Optional WAN number to test (e.g. 1 or 2). Omit to test the active WAN.

dump_raw_data.name: Dump raw data
dump_raw_data.description: Write an unredacted JSON file of everything the controller returns, to config/unifi_wan_dumps/, for your own inspection. Contains IP addresses, MAC addresses, serial numbers and the ISP lookup - do not post it publicly; use Download diagnostics for that.

keep.name: Files to keep
keep.description: How many dumps to keep per gateway before the oldest is deleted.

unknown_wan.message: No configured UniFi gateway has a WAN{wan}. Leave the WAN field empty to test the active WAN.
